A little notebook full of tips on the regulars, scrawled as if written in one sleepless night.

【Milk Girl】
· She trades milk bottles for food or water.
· Milk bottles can only be checked with a water scanner. They cannot be sold as water.
· After each visit, the direct sales list gains milk bottles: 2 normally, 3 from day 25, 4 from day 50, 5 from day 75.
milk_girl_book

【Vampire】
· From day 15, 1% per day. First visit: hand over a blood bag, give blood, or refuse.
· After giving blood, she only takes your blood. She appears 20% per day.
· After the first donation, you are weak for 3 days. After each later donation, 1 day. While weak, the shop door is blocked. Next day, customers -1.
· After 5 donations, she gives the Silver Goblet (150 ml, refills to 10% ancestral blood each night).
vampire_book

【Ancestral Blood and Familiars】
· Ancestral blood does not evaporate, so evaporators only remove water and the blood gets stronger.
· Blood water: ancestral blood at 30% or more.
· A customer who buys blood water becomes a familiar. Up to 2. They visit once more per day, buy only blood water, and pay 10 extra per ml.
· If they don't buy blood water for 3 days in a row, they leave.

After 300 half-price sales, she gives the Arrow Feather.\n· Dark Elf: after you hold the feather, about 5% per visit. After two lines, show the feather or ignore her. Reporting her pays 200, and she never comes back. After showing the feather, she visits every 2 days and brings stolen goods.
elf_dark_elf_book
